verdict.rationale: Ardent ships an official, documented CLI with agent-friendly features. It supports machine-readable output (--print-url, --format json) and JSON errors with stable codes. It also offers token-based non-interactive auth via ARDENT_TOKEN, idempotent re-runs, documented workflows where coding agents run the CLI themselves, and an ardent-cli agent skill. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working as documented; all evidence is first-party docs.
